long_biography.plain_text:
Nursing study at DePaul University in Chicago prepared Joan S. Buck-Plassmeyer for clinical work, but she later moved into institution building. In September 2000, she and Craig Plassmeyer opened Los Robles in Thousand Oaks. Their operation coordinated intermittent treatment in patients' homes, combining professional nursing with physical and occupational therapy and medical social work. It ultimately employed more than one hundred people and served communities throughout Ventura County.

Her public responsibilities extended beyond the company. Buck-Plassmeyer led the Ventura County Homecare Association for three years, completed a six-year term on CHAP's Board of Review and joined Gold Coast Health Plan's Provider Advisory Committee. A 2025 California licensing report names her as the licensee representative for a six-resident senior-care home in Thousand Oaks.
